resolutions.title: Từ để hỏi giữ nguyên vị trí
resolutions.reason: Từ để hỏi giữ nguyên vị trí: Chinese WH-question word-order mechanism.

resolutions.title: 和 nối danh từ
resolutions.reason: 和 nối danh từ: nominal coordination, not aspect/adverb.

resolutions.title: 一边...一边...
resolutions.reason: 一边...一边... links simultaneous parallel actions.

resolutions.title: Bổ ngữ thời lượng: introduction
resolutions.reason: Bổ ngữ thời lượng is the duration/quantity-complement mechanism.

resolutions.title: Bổ ngữ động lượng: introduction
resolutions.reason: Bổ ngữ động lượng is the verbal-frequency/quantity-complement mechanism.

resolutions.title: 只要...就...
resolutions.reason: 只要...就... is a paired conditional connective construction.

resolutions.title: 只有...才...
resolutions.reason: 只有...才... is a restrictive conditional connective construction.

resolutions.title: 得: bổ ngữ mức độ
resolutions.reason: 得: bổ ngữ mức độ explicitly names the degree-complement mechanism.

resolutions.title: 趋向补语 nghĩa mở rộng
resolutions.reason: 趋向补语 nghĩa mở rộng explicitly extends directional complements.

resolutions.title: 是...的 nhấn mạnh
resolutions.reason: 是...的 nhấn mạnh explicitly names the 是...的 focus construction.

resolutions.title: 把 và 被 đối chiếu
resolutions.reason: 把 và 被 đối chiếu is a dedicated contrast between disposal and passive constructions.

resolutions.title: 由于...因此...
resolutions.reason: 由于...因此... is an explicit cause-result connective pair.

resolutions.title: Bổ ngữ thời lượng
resolutions.reason: Bổ ngữ thời lượng is a duration complement.

resolutions.title: Bổ ngữ động lượng
resolutions.reason: Bổ ngữ động lượng is a verbal-frequency complement.

resolutions.title: 按照/根据...
resolutions.reason: 按照/根据... are prepositional/coverb framing expressions.

resolutions.title: 来得及/来不及
resolutions.reason: 来得及/来不及 is a potential-complement pattern expressing feasibility in time.

resolutions.title: 由...组成 / 由...负责
resolutions.reason: 由...组成 / 由...负责 uses 由 as a source/agent prepositional frame.

resolutions.title: 所 + V: introduction
resolutions.reason: 所 + V introduction is the 所 nominalization/relative-like structure.

resolutions.title: 然而/不过/可是
resolutions.reason: 然而/不过/可是 are contrastive discourse connectors.

resolutions.title: 除非...否则...
resolutions.reason: 除非...否则... is an unless/otherwise conditional connective pair.

resolutions.title: 不管/无论...都...
resolutions.reason: 不管/无论...都... is a concessive/generalizing connective construction.

resolutions.title: 宁可...也不...
resolutions.reason: 宁可...也不... is a paired preference/contrast construction.

resolutions.title: 哪怕/即便...也...
resolutions.reason: 哪怕/即便...也... is a concessive connective construction.

resolutions.title: 之所以...是因为...
resolutions.reason: 之所以...是因为... encodes an explicit reason/explanation relation.

resolutions.title: 不是...而是...
resolutions.reason: 不是...而是... is a corrective contrast construction.

resolutions.title: 无非/不过是
resolutions.reason: 无非/不过是 restrict or downscale the proposition's scope/interpretation.

resolutions.title: 并非/并不是
resolutions.reason: 并非/并不是 is advanced propositional negation.

resolutions.title: 未必/不见得
resolutions.reason: 未必/不见得 express epistemic uncertainty/qualification.

resolutions.title: 难免/免不了
resolutions.reason: 难免/免不了 express evaluated likelihood/inevitability.

resolutions.title: 务必/切勿/不得
resolutions.reason: 务必/切勿/不得 encode strong obligation/prohibition.

resolutions.title: 了/过/着 tương tác nâng cao
resolutions.reason: 了/过/着 tương tác nâng cao explicitly compares interacting aspect markers.

resolutions.title: Complex complements
resolutions.reason: Complex complements integrates multiple complement mechanisms at advanced level.

resolutions.title: Long sentence parsing
resolutions.reason: Long sentence parsing is an integration/review task over real clause structures.

resolutions.title: Compression and expansion
resolutions.reason: Compression and expansion explicitly trains structural sentence transformation.

resolutions.title: Approximation and limitation
resolutions.reason: Approximation and limitation concerns scope/degree/limiting expressions.

resolutions.title: Reference chains
resolutions.reason: Reference chains are discourse-level anaphora/reference tracking.

resolutions.title: 恐怕/大概/显然/据说
resolutions.reason: 恐怕/大概/显然/据说 encode stance, certainty and evidential source.

resolutions.title: 只要/只有/除非/倘若/假如/一旦
resolutions.reason: 只要/只有/除非/倘若/假如/一旦 is an advanced conditional-connective set.

resolutions.title: Vietnamese transfer errors
resolutions.reason: Vietnamese transfer errors is a contrastive error-analysis/review unit, not one isolated grammar form.

resolutions.title: Punctuation and clause grammar
resolutions.reason: Punctuation and clause grammar concerns clause boundary/linking in written syntax.

resolutions.title: Summary and reformulation structures
resolutions.reason: Summary and reformulation structures are discourse-level restatement/compression patterns.

resolutions.title: Argument qualification
resolutions.reason: Argument qualification is stance/hedging/limitation in formal discourse.

resolutions.title: 由 + agent/source
resolutions.reason: 由 + agent/source is an agent/source prepositional frame.

resolutions.title: 所字结构 nâng cao
resolutions.reason: 所字结构 nâng cao is advanced 所 nominalization.

resolutions.title: 并不/未必/不都/都不
resolutions.reason: 并不/未必/不都/都不 is specifically about negation and quantifier scope.

resolutions.title: 者 patterns
resolutions.reason: 者 patterns are nominalizing/person-reference structures.

resolutions.title: 之 patterns
resolutions.reason: 之 patterns are classical/formal nominal-linking structures.

resolutions.title: 使/令/让/促使
resolutions.reason: 使/令/让/促使 are causative predicates/constructions.

resolutions.title: 导致/致使
resolutions.reason: 导致/致使 encode causation/result relations.

resolutions.title: 以致/以至于
resolutions.reason: 以致/以至于 introduce result clauses.

resolutions.title: 就...而言 / 从...来看
resolutions.reason: 就...而言 / 从...来看 frame a proposition from a viewpoint/domain.

resolutions.title: 以便/以免/以期
resolutions.reason: 以便/以免/以期 introduce purpose/avoidance/expectation relations.

resolutions.title: 同位语和插入语
resolutions.reason: 同位语和插入语 explicitly covers apposition and parenthetical structures.
